name.en: Gender-related functional impairment & low life satisfaction

description.en: High functional-impact and low life-satisfaction scores on the GCLS — a treatment-planning and follow-up marker rather than a diagnosis.
description.hi: GCLS पर उच्च कार्यात्मक-प्रभाव एवं निम्न जीवन-संतुष्टि स्कोर — रोग-निर्णय नहीं, वرن उपचार-योजना एवं अनुवर्ती का सूचक।

icd11Chapter: Contextual codes (not a Chapter 06 mental disorder)
mappingNote: Contextual modifier only; never a primary diagnosis. Use it to record that distress about gender is disrupting school/work, relationships, intimacy or home life, and to justify psychosocial support, referral to a gender service and repeat measurement of satisfaction over time.
